remarks: Walk to New Canaan's shops, restaurants and train. This three-bedroom 2.5 bath townhouse is in a well-maintained complex of four units maintained by professional landlord. Hardwood floors throughout. Eat in kitchen, combined living room/ dining room with gas fireplace and slider to stone patio. Yard for playing or entertaining.  Primary with bath and 10-foot ceilings. Two other  bedrooms share a bath. Ample storage in the attic and storage area in garage. Two car garage, cars MUST fit in garage. only space for 2 cars. No pets, association rules. Good credit a must. credit check required. First and two months security at lease signing, no guarantors for lease. 4 hr notice to show. Addendum to lease must be signed. 500k limited liability ins. required. Agent is part of LLC ownership.
